what_happened: Dispatch's Addition-2 'measured complication' (scripts/roadmap-integration.sh does not exist at the real path; only scripts/deprecated/ has it) was accurate at task-274/dispatch filing time but is now stale: dependency task 306 completed since filing and built a brand-new live scripts/roadmap-integration.sh (--print/--regenerate/--prune/--dry-run) at the real non-deprecated path, already registered in 306's own file_scope and in manifest.json. Research corrected file_scope guidance to target the live path, not scripts/deprecated/roadmap-integration.sh.

Task 306 also revealed that neither /todo nor /review currently wires scripts/roadmap-integration.sh's --prune/--regenerate modes at all (zero live callers today, not two) -- so this task's conclusion-stage roadmap update is the FIRST live caller, not a third caller joining an existing two-caller pattern. This simplifies Addition 2's framing: no existing responsibility split needs reconciling against a third caller, because no caller exists yet; only the already-recorded 306 follow-up ('wiring follow-up should be filed for /todo and /review') needs flagging for the user, separately from this task's own first-caller wiring.

Planning discovered that verify-deploy.sh gate 9 (lint/lint-postflight-boundary.sh) scans skill SKILL.md content appearing AFTER a postflight section for Edit-on-source, build-command and MCP patterns. A Move 5 conclusion-stage body written inline in skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md sits after Move 3 (Postflight) and would very likely trip that lint, since the stage legitimately performs exactly those operations. Worked around in the plan's design by siting the executable stage body in a new context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md and leaving SKILL.md only a short pointer stanza, mirroring the existing context/patterns/lit-stage4a-flow.md single-executable-block precedent. Contingency recorded in the plan: if the lint still flags it, scripts/lint/lint-postflight-boundary.sh must be added to file_scope for a declared exemption.

The task's declared file_scope (10 entries) is insufficient for the planned work in three measured ways: (1) it names scripts/deprecated/roadmap-integration.sh, but the live script the roadmap update must consume is agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/roadmap-integration.sh (690 lines, built by the completed roadmap-generation task; the deprecated copy is 944 lines and quarantined); (2) manifest.json's provides.scripts is file-granular (229 explicit entries), so the two new scripts this plan adds cannot deploy without a manifest.json edit, and manifest.json is not declared; (3) the shared dispatch contracts that make upstream contribution mandatory (context/contracts/phase-closure.md, context/contracts/wrap-up.md, scripts/orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh) are not declared either. Because general-implementation-agent.md's commit recipe DROPS out-of-scope paths from a phase commit with a warning, an undeclared path would be silently excluded from every commit. Plan Phase 1 corrects and widens file_scope before any other phase runs.

file_scope for task 273 was already widened to 21 entries (10 original + the 9 planned Phase-1 additions) by a prior /task amendment cycle before this implement dispatch began; only the deprecated->live roadmap-integration.sh path swap remained, saving most of Phase 1's planned work.

Phase 1's file_scope widening checked manifest.json's provides.context granularity (directory-granular, correctly concluding no per-file deploy registration was needed) but missed a SEPARATE file-level registration requirement: check-extension-docs.sh's Rule S requires every deployed context/contracts/*.md file to have a matching entry in index-entries.json (which merges into the deployed context/index.json). verify-deploy.sh gate 3 (doc-lint) failed on this after Phase 2's conclusion-stage.md landed. Fixed by widening file_scope to add agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json and adding the missing entry during Phase 3.

Initial draft of orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh parsed --help inside the argument loop BEFORE sourcing deploy-root-guard.sh, so --help silently succeeded when invoked from the source store -- inconsistent with the sibling convention (verified against roadmap-integration.sh) where deploy-root-guard.sh is sourced first, so even --help refuses from the source store. Fixed by moving the Paths/common.sh/deploy-root-guard.sh/task-lookup-lib.sh sourcing block to immediately after 'set -euo pipefail', before any argument parsing.

Plan Phase 5 Task 2 directed strengthening 'the existing blockers[]/dead_ends pairing' in context/contracts/wrap-up.md, but wrap-up.md (the --hard-only H9 contract) never actually contained a dead_ends field or section -- only blockers[]. dead_ends's canonical definition lives in docs/architecture/handoff-schema.md. Resolved by adding a new dead_ends bullet to wrap-up.md's Field semantics, paired with blockers the same way, rather than silently treating the task item as already satisfied by the blockers-only edit.

The Move 5 pointer stanza plus the two MUST NOT cross-reference sentences initially added ~983 B to skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, pushing it to 23469 B against the configured 21500 B ceiling in context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json (gate 20). Verification was not run until after the full first draft was written. Fixed by compacting the new prose across six successive small edits down to 21476 B (24 B under ceiling), following this file's own established house convention of trimming restatable prose rather than moving the ceiling. Lesson for future SKILL.md edits: check 'wc -c' against the configured ceiling incrementally while drafting, not only after the fact.

commands/orchestrate.md's Output section had only ~104 B of headroom under its 21,000 B configured ceiling (context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json) before this phase's edit. Adding the new Conclusion entry at normal prose length landed at 21,860 B, 860 B over. Closed via seven compaction rounds -- trimming the new Conclusion/--dry-run prose AND a pre-existing adjacent paragraph (the 'two rows above are different directions' System Defects Detected explanation) -- to 20,971 B, 29 B under ceiling, without moving the ceiling. Same lesson as the SKILL.md finding in Phase 7: check wc -c against the configured ceiling while drafting prose additions to a budget-gated file, not only after a full gate run.

verify-deploy.sh gate 13 (whole-tree orphan detection) reports 2 findings across every deploy run this dispatch performed (Phase 3 through Phase 9): .claude/tmp/noop-bash-shapes-86b3bdf0-5907-498e-81ec-4392e7cf56b6 and .claude/tmp/noop-bash-shapes-f86dc99f-a17e-45ef-b893-15c1453e8aa8. These are legitimate, live runtime state files written by hooks/detect-noop-bash.sh for this and a concurrent sibling Claude Code session (the first UUID matches this very dispatch's own scratchpad session id) -- not garbage, and not safe to delete mid-session. They are deployed-but-undeclared from the orphan detector's perspective, a pre-existing gap unrelated to and pre-dating this task's file_scope (first observed during Phase 3, confirmed unchanged in count through every subsequent deploy). This task's acceptance criterion ('verify-deploy.sh ... passes, with gate 9 explicitly confirmed green') is satisfied on gate 9 specifically; the full script's overall exit status is red solely because of this one unrelated, out-of-scope gate 13 finding, which this task does not fix (wrong territory: the orphan detector's exclusion-class list or detect-noop-bash.sh's own cleanup lifecycle, neither declared in this task's file_scope).

Both new scripts (orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh and its test suite) were created via the Write tool without an executable bit (mode 100644, unlike every sibling script's 100755) and this went undetected through Phases 3-4 because every manual verification invoked them as 'bash <script>' (which does not require +x) rather than direct execution. The gap surfaced only at Phase 9's full tests/run-all.sh pass, which checks [ -x "$f" ] before running a discovered suite and loudly [SKIP]s a non-executable one as an 'exec-bit regression'. Fixed by chmod +x on both files (source store and deployed copies); git diff confirms the mode-only change (100644 -> 100755) will land in Phase 9's commit. Lesson: a newly-created .sh script needs an explicit chmod +x check as part of its own creation step, not only a bash-invoked smoke test, because run-all.sh's own direct-execution discovery is the one consumer a bash-prefixed manual test never exercises.

tests/run-all.sh's full pass (Phase 9) surfaced test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh FAILING its own 'baseline fixture is clean' assertion (14 passed, 1 failed). Root-caused by direct reproduction: that suite's fixture symlinks .claude to the REAL repo's deployed tree, so it inherits the same 2 pre-existing tmp/noop-bash-shapes-* orphan files (gate13) PLUS an unrelated gate16 WARN (lean still declares routing_hard/routing_agents_hard) -- none of which this task's file_scope touches or can fix. Confirmed NOT a regression from this task's own edits: gate20 (the budget gate this suite's own cases actually exercise, cases 1/2/3/4/5) all passed; only the full-battery baseline sanity check failed, and only because of the two unrelated pre-existing findings. Recorded as a known, out-of-scope exclusion rather than left silent.

NOOP_BASH_STATE_DIR override not honored', root-caused to the same .claude/tmp/ directory this and concurrent live sessions' own detect-noop-bash.sh hook writes to during the test run -- a test-isolation gap unrelated to this task.
